subject: Vendor initiation: privacy evidence required for PO routing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@orchidsupply.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-03 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor initiation: privacy evidence required for PO routing

Hi Marta / Orchid team,

Thanks for agreeing to get set up with Redwood Inference. Before we kick off PO routing and billing, Procurement needs a small package of security/privacy artifacts we require for our intake. Please provide the following so we can create the PO and complete the vendor gate: 

- Signed DPA (or DocuSign envelope ID)
- SOC 2 report or a link to your trust portal + report date
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Billing contact and remit-to info (for PO/invoice routing)

If you have a canonical folder or a link to a vendor portal where these already live, that works fine — just point us to it. Aim to send anything you have by EOD Wednesday so we can start PO creation early next week.

Next steps on our side: I will loop in Finance for PO number generation once we have the artifacts. Laura, could you confirm if legal needs to review the DPA before PO issuance? Ben, FYI on billing path.

Thanks,

—
Hannah Schmitt
Vendor Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0189

Attachment: procurement-intake-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@orchidsupply.com>

Cc: procurement@orchidsupply.com
Date: 2027-10-03 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor initiation: privacy evidence required for PO routing

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and files attached where available.

- Signed DPA: We e-signed the DPA and sent via DocuSign earlier this morning. Envelope ID: 12345-orchid-dpa.
- SOC 2: We host the latest SOC 2 Type II on our trust portal: https://trust.orchidsupply.com/soc2/report-2027 (report dated 2027-06-15).
- Subprocessors: Attached CSV (orchid_subprocessors_2027-09.csv) with currently engaged subprocessors and country of processing.
- Billing: Invoice contact is accounting@orchidsupply.com; remit-to address is in the attached invoice stub.

We attached the DPA PDF as well; let us know if you require the redline history. If you need legal to sign any additional addenda, please point us to the DocuSign request and we’ll route internally.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Procurement Lead — Orchid Supply Inc.
marta.ruiz@orchidsupply.com

Attachments: Orchid_Supply_DPA_signed.pdf; orchid_subprocessors_2027-09.csv; orchid_invoice_0426.pdf

Hi Marta — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of quick clarifications before we hand to Finance: 

- Laura: can you confirm whether Legal needs to complete a quick DPA check (we can provide the DocuSign envelope and the signed PDF)? If any minor redline remains we should capture it before issuing the PO.
- Ben: once Legal gives the OK, can you create the PO and route to accounting@orchidsupply.com? The invoice & remit details are attached above.
- Rishi: FYI — please note the subprocessor list includes a cloud provider in eu-west-1; confirm that matches our data residency gating for this engagement.

Marta — if you can paste the DocuSign envelope URL here (or the access instructions for the trust portal), that would speed things up.

Thanks all,
Hannah

Thanks — I reviewed the DPA PDF and the DocuSign envelope. No major outstanding legal issues from a commercial DPA perspective. A couple of minor notes: 

- Add retention schedule detail to Section 4 (vendor confirmed via portal it retains only aggregated telemetry for >180 days) — capture as a side note in the vendor file.
- Subprocessor CSV: please confirm whether any subprocessor has access to production PII. If yes, we need the subprocessors' SOC 2 status column populated.

Once Marta confirms the data residency note and whether any subprocessors touch production PII, Legal is fine to proceed. Ben, please standby for PO generation after those small clarifications.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah / Team — quick follow-up:

- Data residency: the eu-west-1 entry in the subprocessor CSV is our analytics vendor; they process aggregated metrics only (no PII). I have added a column to the CSV noting "no production PII access" for each row where applicable and re-attached as orchid_subprocessors_2027-09.csv.
- SOC 2 access: the trust portal link above includes SOC 2 status for each major subprocessor — I pasted the portal shortcut into a text file (orchid_soc2-trust-portal-link.txt) in case your team needs it directly.
- DocuSign: Envelope 12345-orchid-dpa shows as completed; here is the recipient URL: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/status?envelopeId=12345-orchid-dpa

Please confirm once PO is created and we’ll expect the first invoice after the contract start date. Happy to answer any more questions.

Best,
Marta
